name: gizza-ai/markdown-to-slides
summary: Convert Markdown into a self-contained HTML slide deck

tool.description: Convert a Markdown document into a single self-contained, navigable HTML slide deck. Each slide is separated by a thematic break (`---`, `***`, or `___`) on its own line. Markdown is rendered with CommonMark plus GitHub-flavored extensions (tables, task lists, strikethrough, footnotes) and sanitized, then wrapped in one HTML file with embedded CSS and keyboard/click/swipe navigation, a slide counter, and a progress bar — no external dependencies, no build step. Pass the document as `markdown`; optionally set `theme` ("light"|"dark") and a document `title`.

markdown.description: The Markdown document to turn into slides. Slides are separated by a thematic break (`---`, `***`, or `___`) on its own line.

theme.description: Color theme for the generated deck.

title.description: Title for the generated HTML document (the browser tab). Defaults to "Slides".
